body:
@Ivorforce Thanks for the tip! I tried out StringBuffer and the results were even better!

As StringBuffer comes with small string optimization built-in, I've included a second benchmark that uses a longer format string.

Benchmark 1:
```gdscript
func _ready():
	var start := Time.get_ticks_msec()
	var format := "fish %05d frog %07f fish %v"
	var args := [ -5, 3.251, Vector3(0.5, 1.0, 1.5) ]
	for i in range(300000):
		var _output = format % args
		pass
	var end := Time.get_ticks_msec()
	print("%dms" % [end - start])
```

Benchmark 2:
```gdscript
func _ready():
	var start := Time.get_ticks_msec()
	var format := "fishfishfishfishfishfishfishfishfish %05d frogfrogfrogfrogfrogfrogfrog %07f fishfishfishfishfishfishfish %v"
	var args := [ -5, 3.251, Vector3(0.5, 1.0, 1.5) ]
	for i in range(300000):
		var _output = format % args
		pass
	var end := Time.get_ticks_msec()
	print("%dms" % [end - start])
```
| Time (ms) | Base | StringBuilder | StringBuffer |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Benchmark 1 | 1205 | 1027 | 815 |
| Benchmark 2 | 1550 | 1212 | 976 |

With this, changes to StringBuilder are no longer necessary and I have discarded them.
